assumptions.statement: Site boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional (PROV-SITE-001 / PROV-KEY-001..003) because official polygons are not yet published.
assumptions.impact: All area metrics, land-use partition, figures, PDFs and HTML are provisional; recalculate everything when official polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: FAR, building height, density, green ratio, setbacks and building control lines require official regulatory-plan conditions that are not present in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: Development intensity is expressed as concept direction only; floor_area_ratio and building_height_control_m are unknown in metrics.json.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection scopes (Qinghuayuan station site) and blue lines (Qinghe) are concept buffers only; official protection plans and blue lines are required.
assumptions.impact: Cultural landmarks and corridor designs remain conservative concept proposals pending official control lines.

assumptions.statement: Road centerlines, transit connections, station integration and municipal networks are concept alignments without official redlines or sections.
assumptions.impact: Road and transit drawings are conceptual; no engineering alignment or feasibility conclusion is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are conceptual massing proxies because official building surveys, parcel boundaries and ownership data are missing.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish conclusions are withheld pending parcel and survey data.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenario cards, test/validation scenarios, events and community operations are concept proposals subject to data minimization, human review, authorization and regulatory approval.
assumptions.impact: No scenario is claimed as approved or operational; each requires professional deepening and authorization.

assumptions.statement: Eight global ecosystem case studies are background references from public reporting; facts and transfer mechanisms require verification before use.
assumptions.impact: Cases inform mechanism design only and are not formal evidence.
